from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import sys,json,hashlib,math
import numpy as np
import torch
root=Path('controlled_furrowing').resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from quadratic_quadrature_study import AxisymmetricModel,IntegrationPolicy,Parameters,source_hashes,evaluate
torch.set_num_threads(1)
program=globals().get('program','Replay code retained in original receipt.')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ev=json.loads((root/'evidence/activated_quadrature_evaluation.json').read_text())
rr=json.loads((root/'evidence/activated_quadrature_reequilibration.json').read_text())
assert rr['status']=='COMPLETE' and len(rr['rows'])==6
checks={'six_original_and_new_cases':len(ev['rows'])==len(rr['rows'])==6,'frozen_sources_match_original_protocol':source_hashes()==rr['source_hashes']==ev['protocol']['source_hashes']}
out=[]
for oldrow,newrow in zip(ev['rows'],rr['rows']):
    oldpath=root/oldrow['input'];newpath=root/newrow['file']
    old=json.loads(oldpath.read_text());new=json.loads(newpath.read_text());params=Parameters(**new['parameters'])
    models={name:AxisymmetricModel(params,integration_policy=policy) for name,policy in [('v8s8',IntegrationPolicy(8,8)),('v8s12',IntegrationPolicy(8,12)),('v12s12',IntegrationPolicy(12,12)),('v12s16',IntegrationPolicy(12,16))]}
    gradients={name:m.objective(old['free_displacement'],old['activation_strength'])[1] for name,m in models.items()}
    neweval=evaluate(models['v8s12'],new);cross=evaluate(models['v12s16'],new)
    surface8to12=float(np.max(abs(gradients['v8s8']-gradients['v8s12'])))
    surface12to16=float(np.max(abs(gradients['v12s12']-gradients['v12s16'])))
    volume8to12=float(np.max(abs(gradients['v8s12']-gradients['v12s12'])))
    bounds={}
    m=models['v8s12']
    for name,edges in [('apical',m.top_edges),('basal',m.bottom_edges)]:
        squares=[]
        for a,mid,b in edges:
            delta=[tuple(Q.from_float(float(new['current_nodes'][i][j]))-Q.from_float(float(old['current_nodes'][i][j])) for j in (0,1)) for i in (a,mid,b)]
            controls=[delta[0],tuple(2*delta[1][j]-(delta[0][j]+delta[2][j])/2 for j in (0,1)),delta[2]]
            squares.extend(sum(v*v for v in c) for c in controls)
        square=max(squares);bounds[name]={'squared_upper_bound_exact':str(square),'upper_bound_display_H':math.sqrt(float(square)),'upper_bound_display_um':33.5*math.sqrt(float(square)),
            'proof':'Bezier convex hull bounds norm of difference at every common material parameter; also bounds geometric Hausdorff distance. Exact square is rational; displayed square root approximate. Not Eulerian vertical error or PDE uncertainty.'}
    key=f"lambda{newrow['lambda']}_strength{newrow['strength']}"
    tests={'old_input_hash':sha(oldpath)==oldrow['input_sha256'],'new_input_hash':sha(newpath)==newrow['file_sha256'],
           'old_fails_higher_force_gate':all(v['scaled_force_linf']>1e-7 for v in oldrow['higher_evaluations']),
           'new_stationary_8':new['converged'] and neweval['scaled_force_linf']<1e-7,
           'new_stationary_12':cross['scaled_force_linf']<1e-7,
           'same_field_space':old['reference_nodes']==new['reference_nodes'] and old['triangles']==new['triangles'] and old['parameters']==new['parameters'],
           'same_activation_strength':old['activation_strength']==new['activation_strength'],
           'all_exact_geometry_pass':newrow['exact_geometry']['all_exact_J_positive'] and newrow['exact_geometry']['global_embedding_certified'],
           'surface_rule_force_difference_small':max(surface8to12,surface12to16)<1e-9,
           'volume8_to12_force_difference_small':volume8to12<1e-7,
           'old_as_initial_guess_explicit':'initial_state' in new or 'numerical_initial_state' in new}
    checks.update({key+'_'+k:bool(v) for k,v in tests.items()})
    out.append({'lambda':newrow['lambda'],'strength':newrow['strength'],'new_result':newrow['file'],'new_result_sha256':sha(newpath),
                'old_higher_force':oldrow['higher_evaluations'][0]['scaled_force_linf'],'new_force8':neweval['scaled_force_linf'],'new_force12':cross['scaled_force_linf'],
                'isolated_surface8to12_force_difference':surface8to12,'isolated_surface12to16_force_difference':surface12to16,'isolated_volume8to12_force_difference':volume8to12,
                'exact_same_parameter_curve_difference_bounds':bounds,'shortening_change_um':33.5*newrow['shortening_change'],
                'exact_J_lower':newrow['exact_geometry']['J_lower_exact'],'exact_J_upper':newrow['exact_geometry']['J_upper_exact']})
checks={k:bool(v) for k,v in checks.items()}
receipt={'status':'PASS_SAME_SPACE_INTEGRATION_REVIEW' if all(checks.values()) else 'FAIL','checks':checks,'records':out,'source_hashes':source_hashes(),
         'input_receipt_hashes':{name:sha(root/'evidence'/name) for name in ['activated_quadrature_evaluation.json','activated_quadrature_reequilibration.json','activated_quadrature_synthetic.json']},
         'verification_program':program,'limitations':['No certified quadrature remainder or continuum error','New field is stationary for both declared rules within tolerance, not a proof of globally unique optimum','Same-space integration sensitivity does not replace mesh refinement','One percent local volume criterion has no independently measured biological justification']}
(root/'evidence/activated_quadrature_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'checks':len(checks),'all_pass':all(checks.values()),'records':out},indent=2))
assert all(checks.values()),[k for k,v in checks.items() if not v]
